findings.claim: DeepSeek initial TP8 summary conflicted with its vLLM launch profiles.
findings.evidence: Official vLLM recipe documents DP4+EP with TP1; profiles use TP1/DP4 or TP1/DP8.
findings.correction: Set baseline_tp=1 and describe DP4 baseline plus unbenchmarked DP8 adaptation.

findings.claim: Exact DeepSeek 0731 SGLang support was left generally unresolved despite existing publisher evidence.
findings.evidence: Pinned 0731 model card gives TP4/flashinfer_mxfp4/DSpark command; SGLang cookbook reports4 GB300 with v0.5.16.
findings.correction: Distinguish documented upstream exact0731 path from the local modified TP8 target-only probe.

findings.claim: All target, derivative and draft model pins were null although exact repositories were accessible.
findings.evidence: HF metadata API SHA matches successfully retrieved immutable card/config paths;18 immutable response bodies unchanged on re-fetch.
findings.correction: Pin base and variants in owned records, publish both draft pins and stable source links; parent propagates profile/catalog copies.

findings.claim: DeepSeek root nextn_layers=1 could be mistaken for actual DSpark stage count.
findings.evidence: Pinned rootconfig num_nextn_predict_layers=1; same-revision inferenceconfig n_mtp_layers=3; source constructs DSparkBlock stages 3 under mtp namespace.
findings.correction: Keep metadata labeled, add reference stage count 3, full 46-entry schedule and zero-based target feature IDs.

findings.claim: Kimi mixed NVFP4 runtime discussion omitted NVIDIA’s documented patched vLLM path and did not resolve stable SGLang source inclusion.
findings.evidence: NVIDIA immutable card documents required runtime patch on8 B300; all three upstream vLLM PRs remain open. SGLang35077 merge is ancestor of v0.5.21 (ahead 2211,behind 0).
findings.correction: Keep generic vLLM profile blocked without denying patched support; establish SGLang release-source inclusion while retaining image/dependency uncertainty and cookbook’s mutable development image.

findings.claim: Kimi native MXFP8 headline could be misread as universal runtime activation precision.
findings.evidence: Publisher describes MXFP4/MXFP8 QAT, but native config quantizes routed experts with input_activations null and excludes attention/shared/dense modules.
findings.correction: State exact serialized weight/module scope and leave backend activation execution as a separate contract.

findings.claim: License provenance stayed unresolved or flattened base and derivative terms.
findings.evidence: Exact DeepSeek MIT file plus model-card scope retrieved. NVIDIA card identifies NVIDIA Open Model Agreement and links Kimi terms; derivative checked-in LICENSE matches custom base LICENSE.
findings.correction: Pin and identify each artifact’s stated terms; no blanket legal-clearance claim.

findings.claim: DeepSeek 128x128 FP8 block metadata could be conflated with expert FP4 grouping.
findings.evidence: Pinned reference Linear stores two FP4 values per byte with one E8M0 scale per 32; FP8 path uses128 blocks.
findings.correction: Describe separate precision groups and avoid labeling the native artifact NVFP4 solely from four-bit storage.

findings.claim: DeepSeek 284B versus304B headline counts have different and unresolved scopes.
findings.evidence: vLLM preview-family headline 284B/13B; SGLang exact0731 row 304B/13B. HF serialized-element totals are not a logical main+draft census.
findings.correction: Keep total_b and active_b null; retain family headline separately and explain what census would resolve.

findings.claim: Inferact peak-speed hardware description pairs 4×GB300 with TP16 without clarifying node count.
findings.evidence: Pinned draft card explicitly contains both descriptions; no independently complete topology/run artifact found.
findings.correction: Flag ambiguity and avoid using peak number for engine ranking.

findings.claim: DeepSeek 64K local profiles cannot represent publisher high/max output allowance.
findings.evidence: Exact card recommends maximum output length 384K for high/max; local max_model_len 65536.
findings.correction: Document local shorter application budget and require separate qualification for long-output profile.

findings.claim: Kimi curated configuration table mixed config extraction with card-derived vision labels.
findings.evidence: Config has no named MoonViT-V2/401M fields; these are publisher card claims. Actual vocab_size163840 contrasts with rounded 160K card label.
findings.correction: Mark row provenance, add exact vocab_size and retain rounded parameter counts as publisher headlines.
